messages:
mira: Heads-up — we saw a spike in v1 client errors after yesterday's routing tweak. Clients without the X-Client-Version header are getting routed to v2 and erroring out. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yep, saw it in error-logs. lots of 400s with 'incompatible payload' from the v2 handler. quick grep: `nginx -> proxy -> v2: 400 "payload schema mismatch"` coming from mobile sdk clients (prob v1.2.x).

toni: is this the implicit-handshake gap we talked about? we previously considered a temporary fallback for header-less clients. that would route them to a v1-compat shim.

mira: right — our current prod policy is implicit fallback OFF for perf reasons. but telemetry shows ~30% of requests missing that header on a few tenants, so impact is nontrivial.

june: do we have per-tenant metrics for header presence? i can add a small console card: missing_header_ratio by tenant, by route. would help decide exemptions.

sam: +1. also billing question: if we route to shim, we should bill at v1 rates (or at least annotate invoices). otherwise customers will be surprised. need product signoff.

toni: UX suggestion: console shows a "compat risk" badge next to tenants with >5% missing headers. offer a one-click "auto-exempt for 7 days" that creates a routing-exemption (routes header-less traffic to v1). track in audit log.

deploy-bot: rollout: starting compat-exempt feature-flag deploy to staging (job id: ff-2026-03-21-17).

mira: proposed rollout sequence: (1) enable enhanced telemetry for header_presence; (2) expose console card + badge; (3) enable optional auto-exempt action guarded by rate limits; (4) probe for 24h and optionally auto-create exemptions for tenants meeting thresholds (>10% missing header and >1k requests). if exemption causes >10k forwarded requests, escalate to SE team before auto-applying.

sam: also add a soft-warning response header when we detect header-less clients while running fallback: `X-Compat-Warn: please upgrade client; see https://redwood.ai/upgrade`. this helps customers debug silent failures.

june: routing rule sketch (pseudo JSON):
```
{
  "match": "if header X-Client-Version exists -> route v2; else if tenant.exempt -> route v1; else -> route default (v2)"
}
```
I'll make a prettier console mock.

sam: capacity concern: more traffic to v1 may blow up the older pools. we should gate auto-exemptions behind a capacity guard: if v1_fallback_rate > 5% sustained across region, block auto-exempt and fire an alert.

toni: agreed. add alerting: page eng-runtime oncall when v1-fallback-rate > 5% for 10m, and create dashboard tile for v1 fallback QPS.

mira: i'll draft a short RFC with rollout thresholds, billing implications, and the opt-in/opt-out UX. owners: june (console card + telemetry), sam (quota/billing guard), toni (alerts + oncall runbook). i'll coordinate with SE for tenant communication.

june: will mock UI today and drop screenshots here. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks team. if anyone sees fresh regressions, ping me directly. closing this thread for now; will follow up with RFC link.
